{{Short description|Norwegian biologist}}
'''Asmund Ekern''' (16 January 1930 &ndash; 9 August 2015) was a Norwegian [[biologist]] who specialized in livestock nutrition.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.aftenposten.no/dodsfall/Nekrolog-Asmund-Ekern-8128570.html | title=Nekrolog: Asmund Ekern}}</ref>

He was born in [[Biri, Norway|Biri]] and graduated from the [[Norwegian College of Agriculture]] in 1956. He was subsequently hired there and to continue his education, taking the licentiate degree in 1961 and the [[dr.agric.|doctorate]] in 1973 as well as a master's degree at [[Cornell University]] in 1962. He worked at the Norwegian College of Agriculture as an [[associate professor]] from 1964, and was promoted to [[docent]] in 1970 and professor in 1973.<ref name=ntb>{{cite news|title=Asmund Ekern 60 år 16.1.90|agency=Norwegian News Agency|date=4 January 1990|language=Norwegian}}</ref> He retired in 1999. In 1985 he was elected fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Jubilanter|date=16 January 2000|work=Aftenposten|language=Norwegian|page=23}}</ref>
